colour.description: The colour behind the avatar's icon, picture or initials.

mark.description: What the avatar shows: a named icon, or a picture. Absent shows the agent's initials.

AgentMark.description: What an agent's avatar shows. Exactly one member is present.

icon.description: A named icon from the platform's set.

pictureUrl.description: The uploaded picture's address, to show as an image. It may stop working after a time; read the agent again for a fresh one.

output.description: The agent as it stands now. It is the whole response body.
output.title: GetAgent output

agentId.description: The agent the entry belongs to.

Actor.description: A person or an API client that made a change.

apiClientId.description: The API client, when one made the change or a person made it through one.

displayName.description: The person's or API client's name, as people saw it when the change was made.

userId.description: The person, when a person made the change.

AgentConfiguration.description:
An agent version's configuration: everything about how the agent behaves that a version holds.

The agent's name, description and avatar belong to the agent and are not versioned; who may use the draft and saved versions belongs to the versions' access grant. A configuration is at most 256 KiB as UTF-8 JSON; anything larger is refused with 400 `CONFIGURATION_TOO_LARGE`.

answers.description: How answers are shaped: follow-up questions, citations and media embeds.

attachments.description: Whether people may attach documents in chat, how many and which kinds.

connectors.description: The workspace's connectors the agent may use, at most 20. Exported as a template variable.

contentSafety.description: The guardrail that screens documents attached in chat. Exported as a template variable.

conversation.description: How the chat looks and behaves: the input placeholder and the time zone.

deniedDocuments.description: When true, the answer stream tells the caller which documents were withheld from them. Defaults to false.

guidance.description: Who the agent is and how it behaves, and the text it follows at particular points in an answer. Always present when read.

journey.description: The page people see before and while they work through a stepped workflow, such as onboarding. Absent means the agent has no such page.

knowledgeBases.description: The knowledge bases the agent searches, and how hard, at most 50, each at most once.

liveAvatar.description: A live video avatar that speaks for the agent. Absent means none.

memory.description: Whether the agent remembers people between conversations. Absent means it does not.

models.description: The model for each job in an answer. A job left unset uses its default.

policies.description: The policies the agent's policy reviews and checked phases use, at most 20. Exported as a template variable.

runAs.description: Whose permissions the agent's unattended runs use. Exported as a template variable. Absent means the agent cannot run unattended.

voice.description: Whether the agent speaks its answers, and in which voice. Absent means the browser's own voice.

workflow.description: The phases a conversation moves through, and how they are grouped. Absent means one conversational phase, `answer`.

AgentGuidance.description: Who the agent is and how it behaves, and the text it follows at particular points in an answer.

definitions.description: A glossary of terms the agent reads the same way every time.

identity.description: Who the agent is and whom it serves, at the top of every prompt, at most 4,000 characters. Absent uses the platform's.

instructions.description: How the agent behaves, at most 100,000 characters. Always present when read; an empty string means none.

limitedEvidence.description: What to say when the knowledge bases hold too little to answer. When set, it replaces `instructions` in the reply to a question with no evidence.

relevance.description: What makes an answer relevant to the people this agent serves, and what it should decline.

resultEvaluation.description: How to judge the passages a search finds, for example "prefer the most recent". Not used with the `reranker` evaluation method.

searchTopics.description: How to turn a question into the topics it searches for.

AgentModels.description: The model for each job in an answer. A job left unset uses its default.

answer.description: Writes the answer. The other jobs fall back to this one's model when their own is unset.

classification.description: Decides what kind of message arrived, and whether the question is in scope.

planning.description: Plans the answer: reads the question, plans the searches and reads attached documents.

searchTopics.description: Writes the search topics for a question. Falls back to `planning`, then `answer`.

summary.description: Summarises a long conversation so the answer stays within the model's limits.

title.description: Names a conversation, once. Defaults to a small, fast model, not the answer model.

AgentWorkflow.description: The agent's workflow: the phases a conversation moves through.

capabilities.description: Groups of phases that each run with their own instructions and only their own tools. Absent: every phase shares one set of instructions and one set of tools.

entryPhase.description: The phase a new conversation starts in. Defaults to `answer`, the phase every agent has.

phases.description: The phases, in the order their journey steps are numbered. Always present when read. Lists are replaced whole: to change one phase, send them all back.

AnswerModelSettings.description: The answer job's model and its settings.

maxAttempts.description: How many times a failed call to the model is tried, from 1 to 10. Defaults to 3.

maxContinuations.description: How many times an answer that ran out of output may be continued, from 0 to 5. Defaults to 0, which is off.

maxOutputTokens.description: The most tokens the job may write, from 1 to 16,384. Defaults to 2,048.

model.description: The model, from `GET /v3/models`. Absent uses the job's default.

reasoning.description: Native reasoning, for a model that supports it; refused with 400 for one that does not.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature, from 0 to 1. Absent uses the model's default. Refused with 400 for a model that does not accept it (see `acceptsTemperature` in `GET /v3/models`).

topK.description: Top-K sampling, from 0 to 250. Absent uses the model's default.

topP.description: Nucleus sampling, from 0 to 1. Absent uses the model's default.

citations.description: How the agent cites its sources.

followUpQuestions.description: Whether the agent ends an answer by offering follow-up questions. Defaults to true.

mediaEmbeds.description: Whether the agent shows images and media from the passages it cites.

acceptedTypes.description: The file extensions accepted. Defaults to `pdf`, `docx`, `txt`, `csv` and `md`.

enabled.description: Whether people may attach documents in chat. Defaults to false.

maxByteSize.description: The largest document accepted, in bytes, from 102,400 (100 KB) to 10,485,760 (10 MB). Defaults to 4,718,592 (4.5 MB).

maxFiles.description: The most documents one conversation may hold, from 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.

AttributionChecks.description: Checks that an answer's claims are supported by what it cites.

maxRetries.description: How many times an answer that fails the check may be rewritten, from 0 to 10. Defaults to 2.

mode.description: What happens when an answer fails a check. Defaults to `record`.

model.description: The model that checks. Absent uses `models.planning`.

AvatarVoiceTuning.description: Adjustments to a live avatar's voice.

model.description: Which of the provider's voice models speaks. Absent uses the provider's default.

speed.description: How fast the avatar speaks, from 0.8 to 1.2. Defaults to 1.

stability.description: How steady the voice is, from 0 to 1. Absent uses the provider's default.

style.description: How much the voice exaggerates its style, from 0 to 1. Absent uses the provider's default.

Capability.description: A group of phases the agent handles as one area of work. While a conversation is in one of its phases, the model sees only the capability's instructions and its phases' tools. Moving into a phase of another capability hands the conversation over, with a summary for the next one.

conversationScope.description: Who a conversation in this capability is shared with. Absent decides nothing: the conversation keeps its sharing until it enters a capability that sets one.

description.description: What this capability does, in one sentence. The capability that receives a handover reads it.

id.description: The capability's identifier, unique within the workflow.

instructions.description: Added after the agent's instructions while the capability is active.

phases.description: The phases it owns, at least one. When capabilities are declared, every phase belongs to exactly one.

CitationSettings.description: How an agent cites its sources.

userMessages.description: Whether the agent may cite the person's own earlier messages. Defaults to false.

ConnectorBinding.description: One of the workspace's connectors an agent version may use.

connectorId.description: Which of the workspace's connectors the version may use. The caller must be able to read the connector; one it cannot read is refused with 404 `NOT_FOUND`.

ContentSafety.description: The guardrail that screens documents attached in chat.

guardrail.description: The ID of an entry in `GET /v3/guardrails`, `default` (the platform default, also used when absent) or `none`. The caller must be able to read the entry; one it cannot read is refused with 404 `NOT_FOUND`.

ConversationSettings.description: How the chat looks and behaves.

inputPlaceholder.description: The hint in the empty chat box, at most 200 characters. Absent or empty uses the workspace theme's.

timeZone.description: The time zone dates and "today" are read in, as an IANA name. Defaults to `Pacific/Auckland`.

FieldSource.description: One place a phase field's value may come from.

field.description: For `earlier_phase`: the field it was gathered as.

kind.description: Which place the value comes from. The other members name the tool, the fixed values or the earlier phase.

path.description: For `tool_result`: a path into the tool's output, for example `results[0].id`. Empty means the whole output.

phase.description: For `earlier_phase`: the phase that gathered the value.

toolName.description: For `tool_result`: the tool whose result holds the value.

values.description: For `allowed_values`: the values the field may take, at least one.

HistoryEntry.description: A live history entry. A list leaves `configuration` out; read one entry to get it.

agentId.description: The agent whose live version changed.

changedMembers.description: The members that differ between `previousVersion` and `version`, computed when the entry was written. Lists are compared by their items' keys.

configuration.description: The configuration of `version`. Present only when the caller may read that version, as GetAgentVersion checks: the permission to read versions, and the agent grant and the agent's version access grant. Absent otherwise, in a list, and when that version no longer exists.

id.description: The identifier GetHistoryEntry takes to read this entry with its configuration.

kind.description: What kind of change it was.

note.description: The note written with the change.

previousVersion.description: The version live pointed at before the change. Absent for an agent's first publish.

version.description: The version live pointed at after the change.

HoldingPhrases.description: What a live avatar says while an answer is being written.

followUp.description: What the avatar says to invite the person to clarify when no answer arrived.

groups.description: Groups of phrases, said one group after another while the answer is written.

intervalMs.description: Milliseconds between holding phrases, from 1,000 to 60,000.

openers.description: Phrases that acknowledge the person has finished speaking.

skipChance.description: The chance, from 0 to 1, that any one holding phrase is skipped, so the rhythm sounds less mechanical.

stillProcessing.description: What the avatar says when the answer is taking longer than usual.

JourneyIntroduction.description: The introduction on a journey page.

buttonLabel.description: The button, such as "Begin set-up" or "Continue in your set-up chat".

eyebrow.description: The small label above the title, such as "Getting started". Used on `start` only.

lead.description: The paragraph under the title. Required on `start`.

title.description: The title, such as "Welcome. Let's set up Caitlyn for your organisation."

JourneyPoster.description: The poster on a journey page.

footer.description: Short lines at the foot of the poster, one per line, at most 6.

label.description: The words on the poster, such as "Onboarding".

JourneySettings.description: The page shown for a stepped workflow: a poster on one side, and an introduction that changes once some steps are done. Its steps are the phases' `step` settings, numbered in the order their phases are declared; a step is done when its phases complete, or when its `doneWhen` signal says so.

poster.description: The poster beside the introduction. Always present when read.

resume.description: What a person sees once some steps are done or skipped. Always present when read.

start.description: What a person sees before they start. Always present when read.

JourneyStep.description: A phase's step on the journey page.

doneWhen.description: A named signal that shows the step done outside the chat, such as `workspaceHasCustomTheme`. Absent: the step is done when its phases complete.

id.description: Groups phases into steps on the journey page. Phases that share one form one step.

label.description: What the journey page calls the step, such as "Knowledge base".

KnowledgeBaseBinding.description: One knowledge base an agent searches, and how hard.

description.description: What it holds, so the agent knows when to search it, at most 2,000 characters. Absent uses the knowledge base's own `agentDescription`.

evaluation.description: How the passages a search finds are judged before they reach the answer. One method per search.

knowledgeBaseId.description: The knowledge base searched. The caller must be able to read it.

maxQueries.description: The most searches the agent may write for this knowledge base per question, from 1 to 20. Defaults to 3.

minimumRelevance.description: The lowest relevance an evaluated passage needs to reach the answer, from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.5.

minimumScore.description: The lowest similarity score a passage needs before it is evaluated, from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.3.

numberOfResults.description: How many passages each search retrieves, from 1 to 50. Defaults to 6.

transcriptPanel.description: Whether an audio or video citation shows its transcript beside the player. Absent follows the knowledge base.

LiveAvatarSettings.description: A live video avatar that speaks for the agent. Its provider's key is referenced by `secretId`, never copied, so publishing or resetting from an old version cannot bring back an old key.

answerVersion.description: The version of this agent that answers for the avatar: `live`, or a saved version's name. Absent means this version. `live` follows its moving target, so each publish takes effect without this setting changing; a saved version's name never moves. `draft` is not accepted: saving a configuration that names it is refused with 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`.

avatarId.description: Which of the provider's avatars appears.

holdingPhrases.description: What the avatar says while an answer is being written.

inactivityTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds of silence before the avatar ends the conversation. 0 never ends it.

language.description: The language the avatar speaks, as a BCP 47 tag, for example `en-NZ`.

muteWhileSpeaking.description: When true (the default), the microphone is muted whenever the avatar speaks; when false, only while an answer is being written, so the person can interrupt.

pauseAndResume.description: When set, people can pause the conversation and carry on later.

provider.description: Which company's service runs the avatar. Defaults to `heygen`, the only one.

secretId.description: The stored secret holding the provider's key. Exported as a template variable. The secret must belong to this workspace, and the caller must be allowed to update the agent's integrations, the permission v2 asks for when it stores the key.

speechToText.description: Which service turns what people say into text. Absent uses the platform's.

triggerPhrases.description: Phrases that hand the conversation to the answering version when the avatar says one, at least one.

videoAlignment.description: Which part of the video stays in view on a narrow screen: `left`, `centre`, `right`, or a whole percentage from the left edge, such as `40`.

voiceId.description: Which of the provider's voices the avatar speaks with.

enabled.description: Whether answers show images and media from the passages they cite. Defaults to false.

reservedResults.description: How many search results are kept for media, from 0 to 10. Defaults to 2.

MemorySettings.description: Whether, and how, the agent remembers people between conversations.

enabled.description: Whether the agent remembers. Defaults to false.

maxResults.description: The most memories recalled for one answer, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 10.

memoryStoreId.description: The memory store, from `GET /v3/memory-stores`. Required when `enabled`. The caller must be able to read the store.

minimumRelevance.description: The lowest relevance a memory needs to be recalled, from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.4.

preferences.description: Whether the agent remembers what people prefer. Defaults to false.

summaries.description: Whether the agent remembers summaries of earlier conversations. Defaults to false.

ModelSettings.description: One job's model and its settings.

maxAttempts.description: How many times a failed call to the model is tried, from 1 to 10. Defaults to 3.

maxOutputTokens.description: The most tokens the job may write, from 1 to 16,384. Defaults to 2,048.

model.description: The model, from `GET /v3/models`. Absent uses the job's default.

reasoning.description: Native reasoning, for a model that supports it; refused with 400 for one that does not.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature, from 0 to 1. Absent uses the model's default. Refused with 400 for a model that does not accept it (see `acceptsTemperature` in `GET /v3/models`).

topK.description: Top-K sampling, from 0 to 250. Absent uses the model's default.

topP.description: Nucleus sampling, from 0 to 1. Absent uses the model's default.

PauseAndResume.description: Pausing a live avatar conversation and carrying on later.

openingIntro.description: What the avatar says when a conversation starts fresh, at most 1,000 characters.

pausedTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds a paused conversation stays resumable, from 60,000 to 3,600,000. Defaults to ten minutes.

resumeIntro.description: What the avatar says in place of the intro when a paused conversation resumes, at most 500 characters.

Phase.description: One phase of a workflow. `kind` decides which kind-specific members apply; a member that does not apply to the kind is refused with 400, never ignored.

action.description: For `take_action`: the action the phase takes.

attributionChecks.description: Checks that each answer's claims are supported by what it cites.

fields.description: For `gather_info` and `take_action`: what the phase asks for or needs.

handover.description: For `gather_info`, `take_action` and `policy_review`: how this phase wraps up before it hands over to `next`.

id.description: The phase's identifier, unique within the workflow.

instructions.description: The phase's own instructions, added to the agent's while it runs.

kind.description: What the phase does, which decides which of its other members apply.

maxSteps.description: The most model calls the phase may make in one answer, from 1 to 50. Defaults to 10, or 30 for `policy_review`.

next.description: For `gather_info`, `take_action` and `policy_review`: the phase to move to when this one is done.

onEnd.description: What happens when the phase ends the conversation. Absent means the conversation carries on.

opening.description: What the person sees when a conversation starts in, or enters, this phase.

outcomeDescription.description: For `gather_info`, `take_action` and `policy_review`: what the phase's outcome is, and how later phases should use it.

policyRules.description: For `take_action`: the policy rules this phase checks, as `<policyId>/<ruleId>`. Each policy must be in `policies`. The caller must be able to read each policy, checked on every save as for `policies`; one it cannot read is refused with 404 `NOT_FOUND`.

reasoning.description: Native reasoning while the phase runs.

repliesOnEntry.description: For `conversational`: when true, the phase replies as soon as an earlier phase hands over, rather than waiting for the person. Defaults to false.

responses.description: Set replies the phase may give, each chosen by its description.

review.description: For `policy_review`: the policy the phase reviews against, and which of its rules.

step.description: This phase's step on the journey page, when it is part of one.

toolCallChecks.description: Checks each tool call against a rule before it runs.

tools.description: The tools the phase may use, at most 30.

transitions.description: Where the conversation may go from this phase.

unattended.description: When true, the phase runs with no person: it asks the person nothing, and must finish with its own tools. Defaults to false. For `gather_info`, `take_action` and `policy_review`.

completesOnRequiredTool.description: When true, the phase completes as soon as one of `requiredTools` succeeds. Defaults to false.

description.description: What the action is, in plain words.

requiredTools.description: Tools the agent must call, at least one of them, before the action counts as done. Empty means the agent's own account of what it did is enough.

PhaseEnd.description: What happens when a phase ends the conversation.

closingMessage.description: For `close`: what the person is told.

restartIn.description: For `restart`: the phase the next message starts in. Defaults to the conversation's entry phase.

type.description: What happens to the conversation when the phase ends it.

PhaseField.description: One thing a phase asks for or needs: a field to gather, or an earlier phase that must be done.

acceptedTypes.description: For a `document` field: the file extensions accepted, for example `pdf`.

description.description: For `field`: what the value is. Required on a field.

documentField.description: For a `document` field: the document metadata field the value fills.

id.description: The field's identifier, unique within the phase.

kind.description: Whether the entry is a value the phase gathers or an earlier phase that must be done first. Defaults to `field`.

maxByteSize.description: For a `document` field: the largest file accepted, in bytes.

optional.description: For `field`: when true, the phase may finish without it. Defaults to false.

prerequisite.description: For `prerequisite`: the phase that must be done first. Required on a prerequisite.

request.description: For `field`: how the agent asks for it. Required on a field.

sources.description: For `field`: where the value may come from, in order. Absent means the person.

type.description: For a `field`: what kind of value it holds. Defaults to `text`.

PhaseOpening.description: What the person sees when a conversation starts in, or enters, a phase.

input.description: A form, buttons or choices shown with the message, as `input.requested` carries one.

message.description: A message shown before the person types anything. `@user:firstName`, `@user:lastName` and `@user:email` are replaced with the person's details.

onEveryEntry.description: When true, the opening is shown whenever the conversation enters the phase, not only when a conversation starts in it. Defaults to false.

PhaseResponse.description: A set reply a phase may give, chosen by its description.

description.description: When the agent gives this reply.

id.description: The reply's identifier, unique within the phase.

request.description: What the agent says.

PhaseTool.description: A tool a phase may use: one of Caitlyn's own, or the tools on an MCP server.

citationLabel.description: What a citation of this tool's results is called, for example "Policy register".

description.description: What the tool is for, in the agent's words. Absent uses the tool's own description.

enabled.description: Whether the phase may use the tool. Defaults to true.

excludedTools.description: With `mcpServerId` and no `tools`: the server's tools the phase may not use.

mcpServerId.description: An MCP server whose tools the phase may use. Exactly one of `name` and `mcpServerId`. With no `tools`, every tool on the server, including tools it adds later; otherwise only those listed. Exported as a template variable. The caller must be able to read the server.

name.description: One of Caitlyn's own tools, from `GET /v3/tools`. Exactly one of `name` and `mcpServerId`.

search.description: For Caitlyn's knowledge base search tool: how it searches.

tools.description: With `mcpServerId`: only these of the server's tools.

use.description: How the agent uses what the tool returns. Defaults to `default`.

PhaseTransition.description: A way out of a phase.

condition.description: The condition, in plain words, that makes this the way out. The agent decides by it.

handover.description: How this phase wraps up before it hands over through this way out.

kind.description: How the way out is gated. Defaults to `alternative`.

notStartedIn.description: Never when the conversation started in one of these phases.

requiresUserChoice.description: When true, the agent may take this way out only on the person's express choice. Defaults to false.

skipLabel.description: For `skip`: the words on the chat's skip button, such as "Skip theme configuration". Required on a skip.

startedIn.description: Only when the conversation started in one of these phases.

when.description: Takes this way out automatically when a value matches, without the agent deciding.

PolicyBinding.description: One policy an agent version uses.

policyId.description: Which policy the version may review documents against. The caller must be able to read the policy. This is checked for every policy id sent, not only new ones, because the rules go into the cached prompt. A policy the caller cannot read is refused with 404 `NOT_FOUND`.

PolicyReviewSettings.description: The policy a `policy_review` phase reviews against.

policyId.description: Which policy the phase reviews against. It must be in `policies`. The caller must be able to read the policy. This is checked for every policy id sent, not only new ones, because the rules go into the cached prompt. A policy the caller cannot read is refused with 404 `NOT_FOUND`.

reviewStageId.description: The policy's review stage this phase reviews at. Absent for a policy with no review stages.

ruleIds.description: The rules to check. Absent means every rule in the policy, read again each time a review starts.

ReasoningSettings.description: Native reasoning ("extended thinking") for a model that supports it.

effort.description: How much effort the model spends reasoning. Absent uses the model's default. Refused with 400 for a level the model does not list in `effortLevels`.

enabled.description: Whether the model reasons before it answers. Defaults to false; a model whose `reasoning` is `always` reasons whatever this says.

ResultEvaluation.description: How the passages a search finds are judged.

judge.description: For `model`: the model that judges each passage. Unset members fall back to `models.planning`.

maxResults.description: The most passages kept after evaluation, from 1 to 100, and at most `maxQueries` × `maxSearchResults`. Defaults to 10.

maxSearchResults.description: The most passages each search keeps for evaluation, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 10.

method.description: What judges the search results. Defaults to `reranker`.

reranker.description: For `reranker`: the reranking model, from `GET /v3/models`. Absent uses the platform's preference.

RunAs.description: Whose permissions an unattended run of this version uses.

roleId.description: The role whose permissions unattended runs use. The caller may name only a role it could assign.

maxAttempts.description: How many times a failed call to the model is tried, from 1 to 10. Defaults to 2.

maxOutputTokens.description: The most tokens a title may take, from 1 to 512. Defaults to 32.

model.description: The model, from `GET /v3/models`. Absent uses a small, fast model.

ToolCallChecks.description: Checks each tool call against a rule before it runs.

maxRetries.description: How many times a refused call may be corrected, from 0 to 10. Defaults to 2.

model.description: The model that checks. Absent uses `models.planning`.

policy.description: The rule, in plain words, every tool call is checked against.

ToolSearchSettings.description: How Caitlyn's knowledge base search tool searches.

modes.description: The search modes the agent may choose from, at least one.

version.description: The version of this agent whose knowledge bases and search settings the tool uses: `live`, or a saved version's name. `live` follows its moving target, so each publish takes effect without this setting changing; a saved version's name never moves. `draft` is not accepted: saving a configuration that names it is refused with 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`.

TransitionMatch.description: A value that takes a way out of a phase automatically.

equals.description: The value the field must hold: a string, number or boolean. A saved field is compared as a string.

field.description: For `tool_result`, a dotted path into the tool's output, for example `isCovered`; for `saved_field`, a field of this phase.

source.description: Where the value is read from. Defaults to `tool_result`.

VoiceSettings.description: Whether, and how, the agent speaks its answers.

language.description: The language and accent, as a BCP 47 tag, for example `en-NZ`. Defaults to `en-NZ`.

provider.description: What speaks the agent's answers. Defaults to `browser`. The voices on offer are listed by `GET /v3/voices`.

quality.description: For a cloud voice: how natural it sounds. Defaults to `natural`.

voiceId.description: For `cloud`: the voice, from `GET /v3/voices`, for example `Aria`.

output.description: The history entry, with the configuration of the version it names. It is the whole response body.
output.title: GetHistoryEntry output

agentId.description: The agent whose live history to list.

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous page. Absent for the first page.

limit.description: The most entries to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

Actor.description: A person or an API client that made a change.

apiClientId.description: The API client, when one made the change or a person made it through one.

displayName.description: The person's or API client's name, as people saw it when the change was made.

userId.description: The person, when a person made the change.

AgentConfiguration.description:
An agent version's configuration: everything about how the agent behaves that a version holds.

The agent's name, description and avatar belong to the agent and are not versioned; who may use the draft and saved versions belongs to the versions' access grant. A configuration is at most 256 KiB as UTF-8 JSON; anything larger is refused with 400 `CONFIGURATION_TOO_LARGE`.

answers.description: How answers are shaped: follow-up questions, citations and media embeds.

attachments.description: Whether people may attach documents in chat, how many and which kinds.

connectors.description: The workspace's connectors the agent may use, at most 20. Exported as a template variable.

contentSafety.description: The guardrail that screens documents attached in chat. Exported as a template variable.

conversation.description: How the chat looks and behaves: the input placeholder and the time zone.

deniedDocuments.description: When true, the answer stream tells the caller which documents were withheld from them. Defaults to false.

guidance.description: Who the agent is and how it behaves, and the text it follows at particular points in an answer. Always present when read.

journey.description: The page people see before and while they work through a stepped workflow, such as onboarding. Absent means the agent has no such page.

knowledgeBases.description: The knowledge bases the agent searches, and how hard, at most 50, each at most once.

liveAvatar.description: A live video avatar that speaks for the agent. Absent means none.

memory.description: Whether the agent remembers people between conversations. Absent means it does not.

models.description: The model for each job in an answer. A job left unset uses its default.

policies.description: The policies the agent's policy reviews and checked phases use, at most 20. Exported as a template variable.

runAs.description: Whose permissions the agent's unattended runs use. Exported as a template variable. Absent means the agent cannot run unattended.

voice.description: Whether the agent speaks its answers, and in which voice. Absent means the browser's own voice.

workflow.description: The phases a conversation moves through, and how they are grouped. Absent means one conversational phase, `answer`.

AgentGuidance.description: Who the agent is and how it behaves, and the text it follows at particular points in an answer.

definitions.description: A glossary of terms the agent reads the same way every time.

identity.description: Who the agent is and whom it serves, at the top of every prompt, at most 4,000 characters. Absent uses the platform's.

instructions.description: How the agent behaves, at most 100,000 characters. Always present when read; an empty string means none.

limitedEvidence.description: What to say when the knowledge bases hold too little to answer. When set, it replaces `instructions` in the reply to a question with no evidence.

relevance.description: What makes an answer relevant to the people this agent serves, and what it should decline.

resultEvaluation.description: How to judge the passages a search finds, for example "prefer the most recent". Not used with the `reranker` evaluation method.

searchTopics.description: How to turn a question into the topics it searches for.

AgentModels.description: The model for each job in an answer. A job left unset uses its default.

answer.description: Writes the answer. The other jobs fall back to this one's model when their own is unset.

classification.description: Decides what kind of message arrived, and whether the question is in scope.

planning.description: Plans the answer: reads the question, plans the searches and reads attached documents.

searchTopics.description: Writes the search topics for a question. Falls back to `planning`, then `answer`.

summary.description: Summarises a long conversation so the answer stays within the model's limits.

title.description: Names a conversation, once. Defaults to a small, fast model, not the answer model.

AgentWorkflow.description: The agent's workflow: the phases a conversation moves through.

capabilities.description: Groups of phases that each run with their own instructions and only their own tools. Absent: every phase shares one set of instructions and one set of tools.

entryPhase.description: The phase a new conversation starts in. Defaults to `answer`, the phase every agent has.

phases.description: The phases, in the order their journey steps are numbered. Always present when read. Lists are replaced whole: to change one phase, send them all back.

AnswerModelSettings.description: The answer job's model and its settings.

maxAttempts.description: How many times a failed call to the model is tried, from 1 to 10. Defaults to 3.

maxContinuations.description: How many times an answer that ran out of output may be continued, from 0 to 5. Defaults to 0, which is off.

maxOutputTokens.description: The most tokens the job may write, from 1 to 16,384. Defaults to 2,048.

model.description: The model, from `GET /v3/models`. Absent uses the job's default.

reasoning.description: Native reasoning, for a model that supports it; refused with 400 for one that does not.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature, from 0 to 1. Absent uses the model's default. Refused with 400 for a model that does not accept it (see `acceptsTemperature` in `GET /v3/models`).

topK.description: Top-K sampling, from 0 to 250. Absent uses the model's default.

topP.description: Nucleus sampling, from 0 to 1. Absent uses the model's default.

citations.description: How the agent cites its sources.

followUpQuestions.description: Whether the agent ends an answer by offering follow-up questions. Defaults to true.

mediaEmbeds.description: Whether the agent shows images and media from the passages it cites.

acceptedTypes.description: The file extensions accepted. Defaults to `pdf`, `docx`, `txt`, `csv` and `md`.

enabled.description: Whether people may attach documents in chat. Defaults to false.

maxByteSize.description: The largest document accepted, in bytes, from 102,400 (100 KB) to 10,485,760 (10 MB). Defaults to 4,718,592 (4.5 MB).

maxFiles.description: The most documents one conversation may hold, from 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.

AttributionChecks.description: Checks that an answer's claims are supported by what it cites.

maxRetries.description: How many times an answer that fails the check may be rewritten, from 0 to 10. Defaults to 2.

mode.description: What happens when an answer fails a check. Defaults to `record`.

model.description: The model that checks. Absent uses `models.planning`.

AvatarVoiceTuning.description: Adjustments to a live avatar's voice.

model.description: Which of the provider's voice models speaks. Absent uses the provider's default.

speed.description: How fast the avatar speaks, from 0.8 to 1.2. Defaults to 1.

stability.description: How steady the voice is, from 0 to 1. Absent uses the provider's default.

style.description: How much the voice exaggerates its style, from 0 to 1. Absent uses the provider's default.

Capability.description: A group of phases the agent handles as one area of work. While a conversation is in one of its phases, the model sees only the capability's instructions and its phases' tools. Moving into a phase of another capability hands the conversation over, with a summary for the next one.

conversationScope.description: Who a conversation in this capability is shared with. Absent decides nothing: the conversation keeps its sharing until it enters a capability that sets one.

description.description: What this capability does, in one sentence. The capability that receives a handover reads it.

id.description: The capability's identifier, unique within the workflow.

instructions.description: Added after the agent's instructions while the capability is active.

phases.description: The phases it owns, at least one. When capabilities are declared, every phase belongs to exactly one.

CitationSettings.description: How an agent cites its sources.

userMessages.description: Whether the agent may cite the person's own earlier messages. Defaults to false.

ConnectorBinding.description: One of the workspace's connectors an agent version may use.

connectorId.description: Which of the workspace's connectors the version may use. The caller must be able to read the connector; one it cannot read is refused with 404 `NOT_FOUND`.

ContentSafety.description: The guardrail that screens documents attached in chat.

guardrail.description: The ID of an entry in `GET /v3/guardrails`, `default` (the platform default, also used when absent) or `none`. The caller must be able to read the entry; one it cannot read is refused with 404 `NOT_FOUND`.

ConversationSettings.description: How the chat looks and behaves.

inputPlaceholder.description: The hint in the empty chat box, at most 200 characters. Absent or empty uses the workspace theme's.

timeZone.description: The time zone dates and "today" are read in, as an IANA name. Defaults to `Pacific/Auckland`.

FieldSource.description: One place a phase field's value may come from.

field.description: For `earlier_phase`: the field it was gathered as.

kind.description: Which place the value comes from. The other members name the tool, the fixed values or the earlier phase.

path.description: For `tool_result`: a path into the tool's output, for example `results[0].id`. Empty means the whole output.

phase.description: For `earlier_phase`: the phase that gathered the value.

toolName.description: For `tool_result`: the tool whose result holds the value.

values.description: For `allowed_values`: the values the field may take, at least one.

HistoryEntry.description: A live history entry. A list leaves `configuration` out; read one entry to get it.

agentId.description: The agent whose live version changed.

changedMembers.description: The members that differ between `previousVersion` and `version`, computed when the entry was written. Lists are compared by their items' keys.

configuration.description: The configuration of `version`. Present only when the caller may read that version, as GetAgentVersion checks: the permission to read versions, and the agent grant and the agent's version access grant. Absent otherwise, in a list, and when that version no longer exists.

id.description: The identifier GetHistoryEntry takes to read this entry with its configuration.

kind.description: What kind of change it was.

note.description: The note written with the change.

previousVersion.description: The version live pointed at before the change. Absent for an agent's first publish.

version.description: The version live pointed at after the change.

HoldingPhrases.description: What a live avatar says while an answer is being written.

followUp.description: What the avatar says to invite the person to clarify when no answer arrived.

groups.description: Groups of phrases, said one group after another while the answer is written.

intervalMs.description: Milliseconds between holding phrases, from 1,000 to 60,000.

openers.description: Phrases that acknowledge the person has finished speaking.

skipChance.description: The chance, from 0 to 1, that any one holding phrase is skipped, so the rhythm sounds less mechanical.

stillProcessing.description: What the avatar says when the answer is taking longer than usual.

JourneyIntroduction.description: The introduction on a journey page.

buttonLabel.description: The button, such as "Begin set-up" or "Continue in your set-up chat".

eyebrow.description: The small label above the title, such as "Getting started". Used on `start` only.

lead.description: The paragraph under the title. Required on `start`.

title.description: The title, such as "Welcome. Let's set up Caitlyn for your organisation."

JourneyPoster.description: The poster on a journey page.

footer.description: Short lines at the foot of the poster, one per line, at most 6.

label.description: The words on the poster, such as "Onboarding".

JourneySettings.description: The page shown for a stepped workflow: a poster on one side, and an introduction that changes once some steps are done. Its steps are the phases' `step` settings, numbered in the order their phases are declared; a step is done when its phases complete, or when its `doneWhen` signal says so.

poster.description: The poster beside the introduction. Always present when read.

resume.description: What a person sees once some steps are done or skipped. Always present when read.

start.description: What a person sees before they start. Always present when read.

JourneyStep.description: A phase's step on the journey page.

doneWhen.description: A named signal that shows the step done outside the chat, such as `workspaceHasCustomTheme`. Absent: the step is done when its phases complete.

id.description: Groups phases into steps on the journey page. Phases that share one form one step.

label.description: What the journey page calls the step, such as "Knowledge base".

KnowledgeBaseBinding.description: One knowledge base an agent searches, and how hard.

description.description: What it holds, so the agent knows when to search it, at most 2,000 characters. Absent uses the knowledge base's own `agentDescription`.

evaluation.description: How the passages a search finds are judged before they reach the answer. One method per search.

knowledgeBaseId.description: The knowledge base searched. The caller must be able to read it.

maxQueries.description: The most searches the agent may write for this knowledge base per question, from 1 to 20. Defaults to 3.

minimumRelevance.description: The lowest relevance an evaluated passage needs to reach the answer, from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.5.

minimumScore.description: The lowest similarity score a passage needs before it is evaluated, from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.3.

numberOfResults.description: How many passages each search retrieves, from 1 to 50. Defaults to 6.

transcriptPanel.description: Whether an audio or video citation shows its transcript beside the player. Absent follows the knowledge base.

LiveAvatarSettings.description: A live video avatar that speaks for the agent. Its provider's key is referenced by `secretId`, never copied, so publishing or resetting from an old version cannot bring back an old key.

answerVersion.description: The version of this agent that answers for the avatar: `live`, or a saved version's name. Absent means this version. `live` follows its moving target, so each publish takes effect without this setting changing; a saved version's name never moves. `draft` is not accepted: saving a configuration that names it is refused with 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`.

avatarId.description: Which of the provider's avatars appears.

holdingPhrases.description: What the avatar says while an answer is being written.

inactivityTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds of silence before the avatar ends the conversation. 0 never ends it.

language.description: The language the avatar speaks, as a BCP 47 tag, for example `en-NZ`.

muteWhileSpeaking.description: When true (the default), the microphone is muted whenever the avatar speaks; when false, only while an answer is being written, so the person can interrupt.

pauseAndResume.description: When set, people can pause the conversation and carry on later.

provider.description: Which company's service runs the avatar. Defaults to `heygen`, the only one.

secretId.description: The stored secret holding the provider's key. Exported as a template variable. The secret must belong to this workspace, and the caller must be allowed to update the agent's integrations, the permission v2 asks for when it stores the key.

speechToText.description: Which service turns what people say into text. Absent uses the platform's.

triggerPhrases.description: Phrases that hand the conversation to the answering version when the avatar says one, at least one.

videoAlignment.description: Which part of the video stays in view on a narrow screen: `left`, `centre`, `right`, or a whole percentage from the left edge, such as `40`.

voiceId.description: Which of the provider's voices the avatar speaks with.

enabled.description: Whether answers show images and media from the passages they cite. Defaults to false.

reservedResults.description: How many search results are kept for media, from 0 to 10. Defaults to 2.

MemorySettings.description: Whether, and how, the agent remembers people between conversations.

enabled.description: Whether the agent remembers. Defaults to false.

maxResults.description: The most memories recalled for one answer, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 10.

memoryStoreId.description: The memory store, from `GET /v3/memory-stores`. Required when `enabled`. The caller must be able to read the store.

minimumRelevance.description: The lowest relevance a memory needs to be recalled, from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.4.

preferences.description: Whether the agent remembers what people prefer. Defaults to false.

summaries.description: Whether the agent remembers summaries of earlier conversations. Defaults to false.

ModelSettings.description: One job's model and its settings.

maxAttempts.description: How many times a failed call to the model is tried, from 1 to 10. Defaults to 3.

maxOutputTokens.description: The most tokens the job may write, from 1 to 16,384. Defaults to 2,048.

model.description: The model, from `GET /v3/models`. Absent uses the job's default.

reasoning.description: Native reasoning, for a model that supports it; refused with 400 for one that does not.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature, from 0 to 1. Absent uses the model's default. Refused with 400 for a model that does not accept it (see `acceptsTemperature` in `GET /v3/models`).

topK.description: Top-K sampling, from 0 to 250. Absent uses the model's default.

topP.description: Nucleus sampling, from 0 to 1. Absent uses the model's default.

PauseAndResume.description: Pausing a live avatar conversation and carrying on later.

openingIntro.description: What the avatar says when a conversation starts fresh, at most 1,000 characters.

pausedTimeoutMs.description: Milliseconds a paused conversation stays resumable, from 60,000 to 3,600,000. Defaults to ten minutes.

resumeIntro.description: What the avatar says in place of the intro when a paused conversation resumes, at most 500 characters.

Phase.description: One phase of a workflow. `kind` decides which kind-specific members apply; a member that does not apply to the kind is refused with 400, never ignored.

action.description: For `take_action`: the action the phase takes.

attributionChecks.description: Checks that each answer's claims are supported by what it cites.

fields.description: For `gather_info` and `take_action`: what the phase asks for or needs.

handover.description: For `gather_info`, `take_action` and `policy_review`: how this phase wraps up before it hands over to `next`.

id.description: The phase's identifier, unique within the workflow.

instructions.description: The phase's own instructions, added to the agent's while it runs.

kind.description: What the phase does, which decides which of its other members apply.

maxSteps.description: The most model calls the phase may make in one answer, from 1 to 50. Defaults to 10, or 30 for `policy_review`.

next.description: For `gather_info`, `take_action` and `policy_review`: the phase to move to when this one is done.

onEnd.description: What happens when the phase ends the conversation. Absent means the conversation carries on.

opening.description: What the person sees when a conversation starts in, or enters, this phase.

outcomeDescription.description: For `gather_info`, `take_action` and `policy_review`: what the phase's outcome is, and how later phases should use it.

policyRules.description: For `take_action`: the policy rules this phase checks, as `<policyId>/<ruleId>`. Each policy must be in `policies`. The caller must be able to read each policy, checked on every save as for `policies`; one it cannot read is refused with 404 `NOT_FOUND`.

reasoning.description: Native reasoning while the phase runs.

repliesOnEntry.description: For `conversational`: when true, the phase replies as soon as an earlier phase hands over, rather than waiting for the person. Defaults to false.

responses.description: Set replies the phase may give, each chosen by its description.

review.description: For `policy_review`: the policy the phase reviews against, and which of its rules.

step.description: This phase's step on the journey page, when it is part of one.

toolCallChecks.description: Checks each tool call against a rule before it runs.

tools.description: The tools the phase may use, at most 30.

transitions.description: Where the conversation may go from this phase.

unattended.description: When true, the phase runs with no person: it asks the person nothing, and must finish with its own tools. Defaults to false. For `gather_info`, `take_action` and `policy_review`.

completesOnRequiredTool.description: When true, the phase completes as soon as one of `requiredTools` succeeds. Defaults to false.

description.description: What the action is, in plain words.

requiredTools.description: Tools the agent must call, at least one of them, before the action counts as done. Empty means the agent's own account of what it did is enough.

PhaseEnd.description: What happens when a phase ends the conversation.

closingMessage.description: For `close`: what the person is told.

restartIn.description: For `restart`: the phase the next message starts in. Defaults to the conversation's entry phase.

type.description: What happens to the conversation when the phase ends it.

PhaseField.description: One thing a phase asks for or needs: a field to gather, or an earlier phase that must be done.

acceptedTypes.description: For a `document` field: the file extensions accepted, for example `pdf`.

description.description: For `field`: what the value is. Required on a field.

documentField.description: For a `document` field: the document metadata field the value fills.

id.description: The field's identifier, unique within the phase.

kind.description: Whether the entry is a value the phase gathers or an earlier phase that must be done first. Defaults to `field`.

maxByteSize.description: For a `document` field: the largest file accepted, in bytes.

optional.description: For `field`: when true, the phase may finish without it. Defaults to false.

prerequisite.description: For `prerequisite`: the phase that must be done first. Required on a prerequisite.

request.description: For `field`: how the agent asks for it. Required on a field.

sources.description: For `field`: where the value may come from, in order. Absent means the person.

type.description: For a `field`: what kind of value it holds. Defaults to `text`.

PhaseOpening.description: What the person sees when a conversation starts in, or enters, a phase.

input.description: A form, buttons or choices shown with the message, as `input.requested` carries one.

message.description: A message shown before the person types anything. `@user:firstName`, `@user:lastName` and `@user:email` are replaced with the person's details.

onEveryEntry.description: When true, the opening is shown whenever the conversation enters the phase, not only when a conversation starts in it. Defaults to false.

PhaseResponse.description: A set reply a phase may give, chosen by its description.

description.description: When the agent gives this reply.

id.description: The reply's identifier, unique within the phase.

request.description: What the agent says.

PhaseTool.description: A tool a phase may use: one of Caitlyn's own, or the tools on an MCP server.

citationLabel.description: What a citation of this tool's results is called, for example "Policy register".

description.description: What the tool is for, in the agent's words. Absent uses the tool's own description.

enabled.description: Whether the phase may use the tool. Defaults to true.

excludedTools.description: With `mcpServerId` and no `tools`: the server's tools the phase may not use.

mcpServerId.description: An MCP server whose tools the phase may use. Exactly one of `name` and `mcpServerId`. With no `tools`, every tool on the server, including tools it adds later; otherwise only those listed. Exported as a template variable. The caller must be able to read the server.

name.description: One of Caitlyn's own tools, from `GET /v3/tools`. Exactly one of `name` and `mcpServerId`.

search.description: For Caitlyn's knowledge base search tool: how it searches.

tools.description: With `mcpServerId`: only these of the server's tools.

use.description: How the agent uses what the tool returns. Defaults to `default`.

PhaseTransition.description: A way out of a phase.

condition.description: The condition, in plain words, that makes this the way out. The agent decides by it.

handover.description: How this phase wraps up before it hands over through this way out.

kind.description: How the way out is gated. Defaults to `alternative`.

notStartedIn.description: Never when the conversation started in one of these phases.

requiresUserChoice.description: When true, the agent may take this way out only on the person's express choice. Defaults to false.

skipLabel.description: For `skip`: the words on the chat's skip button, such as "Skip theme configuration". Required on a skip.

startedIn.description: Only when the conversation started in one of these phases.

when.description: Takes this way out automatically when a value matches, without the agent deciding.

PolicyBinding.description: One policy an agent version uses.

policyId.description: Which policy the version may review documents against. The caller must be able to read the policy. This is checked for every policy id sent, not only new ones, because the rules go into the cached prompt. A policy the caller cannot read is refused with 404 `NOT_FOUND`.

PolicyReviewSettings.description: The policy a `policy_review` phase reviews against.

policyId.description: Which policy the phase reviews against. It must be in `policies`. The caller must be able to read the policy. This is checked for every policy id sent, not only new ones, because the rules go into the cached prompt. A policy the caller cannot read is refused with 404 `NOT_FOUND`.

reviewStageId.description: The policy's review stage this phase reviews at. Absent for a policy with no review stages.

ruleIds.description: The rules to check. Absent means every rule in the policy, read again each time a review starts.

ReasoningSettings.description: Native reasoning ("extended thinking") for a model that supports it.

effort.description: How much effort the model spends reasoning. Absent uses the model's default. Refused with 400 for a level the model does not list in `effortLevels`.

enabled.description: Whether the model reasons before it answers. Defaults to false; a model whose `reasoning` is `always` reasons whatever this says.

ResultEvaluation.description: How the passages a search finds are judged.

judge.description: For `model`: the model that judges each passage. Unset members fall back to `models.planning`.

maxResults.description: The most passages kept after evaluation, from 1 to 100, and at most `maxQueries` × `maxSearchResults`. Defaults to 10.

maxSearchResults.description: The most passages each search keeps for evaluation, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 10.

method.description: What judges the search results. Defaults to `reranker`.

reranker.description: For `reranker`: the reranking model, from `GET /v3/models`. Absent uses the platform's preference.

RunAs.description: Whose permissions an unattended run of this version uses.

roleId.description: The role whose permissions unattended runs use. The caller may name only a role it could assign.

maxAttempts.description: How many times a failed call to the model is tried, from 1 to 10. Defaults to 2.

maxOutputTokens.description: The most tokens a title may take, from 1 to 512. Defaults to 32.

model.description: The model, from `GET /v3/models`. Absent uses a small, fast model.

ToolCallChecks.description: Checks each tool call against a rule before it runs.

maxRetries.description: How many times a refused call may be corrected, from 0 to 10. Defaults to 2.

model.description: The model that checks. Absent uses `models.planning`.

policy.description: The rule, in plain words, every tool call is checked against.

ToolSearchSettings.description: How Caitlyn's knowledge base search tool searches.

modes.description: The search modes the agent may choose from, at least one.

version.description: The version of this agent whose knowledge bases and search settings the tool uses: `live`, or a saved version's name. `live` follows its moving target, so each publish takes effect without this setting changing; a saved version's name never moves. `draft` is not accepted: saving a configuration that names it is refused with 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`.

TransitionMatch.description: A value that takes a way out of a phase automatically.

equals.description: The value the field must hold: a string, number or boolean. A saved field is compared as a string.

field.description: For `tool_result`, a dotted path into the tool's output, for example `isCovered`; for `saved_field`, a field of this phase.

source.description: Where the value is read from. Defaults to `tool_result`.

VoiceSettings.description: Whether, and how, the agent speaks its answers.

language.description: The language and accent, as a BCP 47 tag, for example `en-NZ`. Defaults to `en-NZ`.

provider.description: What speaks the agent's answers. Defaults to `browser`. The voices on offer are listed by `GET /v3/voices`.

quality.description: For a cloud voice: how natural it sounds. Defaults to `natural`.

voiceId.description: For `cloud`: the voice, from `GET /v3/voices`, for example `Aria`.

items.description: This page of entries, newest first.

nextCursor.description: The cursor for the next page. Absent on the last page.

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` from the previous page. Absent for the first page.

limit.description: The most agents to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20.

Agent.description: An agent: its name, description, avatar and which version is live.

avatar.description: How the agent looks in lists and in the chat. Not versioned.

description.description: What the agent is for. Not versioned. Where a version's handover readers find no description of their own, they use this one.

etag.description: The agent's ETag; send it as `If-Match` to change it.

id.description: The identifier every call about this agent takes; it never changes.

liveVersion.description: The version live points at. Absent until the agent's first publish.

name.description: What people see the agent called, in the app and in chat. Not versioned.

updatedAt.description: When the agent's name, description or avatar last changed.

colour.description: The colour behind the avatar's icon, picture or initials.

mark.description: What the avatar shows: a named icon, or a picture. Absent shows the agent's initials.

AgentMark.description: What an agent's avatar shows. Exactly one member is present.

icon.description: A named icon from the platform's set.

pictureUrl.description: The uploaded picture's address, to show as an image. It may stop working after a time; read the agent again for a fresh one.

nextCursor.description: The cursor for the next page. Absent on the last page.

agentId.description: The agent whose versions are compared.

version.description: The version compared from: `draft`, `live` or a version name.

withVersion.description: The version compared to: `draft`, `live` or a version name.

AgentVersionChange.description: One member that differs between two versions.

after.description: Its value in the version compared to. Absent when the other version removed it.

before.description: Its value in the version compared from. Absent when the other version added it.

path.description: The member, as a path.

changes.description: One change per member that differs, in path order.

agentId.description: The agent to talk to.

idempotencyKey.description: Makes the request safe to retry. The SDKs generate one per call when the caller does not supply one.

title.description: A title for the conversation. Absent means the app titles it from the first message.

version.description: The version of the agent that answers: `live`, `draft` or a version name.

Conversation.description: A conversation between a caller and an agent version.

agentId.description: The agent the conversation is with.

id.description: The identifier every call about this conversation takes; it never changes.

status.description: Whether an answer is being written now.

title.description: The conversation's title, when it has one yet.

updatedAt.description: When the last message was written.

version.description: The version of the agent that answers, as it was asked for: `live`, `draft` or a version name.

output.description: The new conversation. It is the whole response body.
output.title: CreateConversation output

agentId.description: The agent whose version is read.

version.description: `draft`, `live` or a version name.

Actor.description: A person or an API client that made a change.

apiClientId.description: The API client, when one made the change or a person made it through one.

displayName.description: The person's or API client's name, as people saw it when the change was made.

userId.description: The person, when a person made the change.

AgentConfiguration.description:
An agent version's configuration: everything about how the agent behaves that a version holds.

The agent's name, description and avatar belong to the agent and are not versioned; who may use the draft and saved versions belongs to the versions' access grant. A configuration is at most 256 KiB as UTF-8 JSON; anything larger is refused with 400 `CONFIGURATION_TOO_LARGE`.

answers.description: How answers are shaped: follow-up questions, citations and media embeds.

attachments.description: Whether people may attach documents in chat, how many and which kinds.

connectors.description: The workspace's connectors the agent may use, at most 20. Exported as a template variable.

contentSafety.description: The guardrail that screens documents attached in chat. Exported as a template variable.

conversation.description: How the chat looks and behaves: the input placeholder and the time zone.

deniedDocuments.description: When true, the answer stream tells the caller which documents were withheld from them. Defaults to false.

guidance.description: Who the agent is and how it behaves, and the text it follows at particular points in an answer. Always present when read.

journey.description: The page people see before and while they work through a stepped workflow, such as onboarding. Absent means the agent has no such page.

knowledgeBases.description: The knowledge bases the agent searches, and how hard, at most 50, each at most once.

liveAvatar.description: A live video avatar that speaks for the agent. Absent means none.

memory.description: Whether the agent remembers people between conversations. Absent means it does not.

models.description: The model for each job in an answer. A job left unset uses its default.

policies.description: The policies the agent's policy reviews and checked phases use, at most 20. Exported as a template variable.

runAs.description: Whose permissions the agent's unattended runs use. Exported as a template variable. Absent means the agent cannot run unattended.

voice.description: Whether the agent speaks its answers, and in which voice. Absent means the browser's own voice.

workflow.description: The phases a conversation moves through, and how they are grouped. Absent means one conversational phase, `answer`.

AgentGuidance.description: Who the agent is and how it behaves, and the text it follows at particular points in an answer.

definitions.description: A glossary of terms the agent reads the same way every time.

identity.description: Who the agent is and whom it serves, at the top of every prompt, at most 4,000 characters. Absent uses the platform's.

instructions.description: How the agent behaves, at most 100,000 characters. Always present when read; an empty string means none.

limitedEvidence.description: What to say when the knowledge bases hold too little to answer. When set, it replaces `instructions` in the reply to a question with no evidence.

relevance.description: What makes an answer relevant to the people this agent serves, and what it should decline.

resultEvaluation.description: How to judge the passages a search finds, for example "prefer the most recent". Not used with the `reranker` evaluation method.

searchTopics.description: How to turn a question into the topics it searches for.

AgentModels.description: The model for each job in an answer. A job left unset uses its default.

answer.description: Writes the answer. The other jobs fall back to this one's model when their own is unset.

classification.description: Decides what kind of message arrived, and whether the question is in scope.

planning.description: Plans the answer: reads the question, plans the searches and reads attached documents.

searchTopics.description: Writes the search topics for a question. Falls back to `planning`, then `answer`.

summary.description: Summarises a long conversation so the answer stays within the model's limits.

title.description: Names a conversation, once. Defaults to a small, fast model, not the answer model.

AgentVersion.description: A named version of an agent: `draft`, `live` or a saved version. A list leaves `configuration` out; read one version to get it.

agentId.description: The agent the version belongs to.

basedOn.description: The version this one was made from, where there is one.

changedMembers.description: The members that differ from the version this one was made from (`basedOn`); for the draft, from live. Lists are compared by their items' keys.

configuration.description: The version's configuration. Present on a single read and on the draft operations; absent in ListAgentVersions rows and in PublishAgentVersion's `version`.

createdAt.description: When the version was made; for the draft, when it was first created.

createdBy.description: Who made the version. Absent on the draft and on versions carried over from before v3.

etag.description: The version's current ETag; send it as `If-Match` to change it. On `live`, it changes whenever live moves to another version.

liveVersion.description: On `live`: the name of the version live points at.

matchesLive.description: True on the version live points at, and on `live` itself. Defaults to false.

name.description: `draft`, `live` or the version's name.

note.description: The note written when the version was saved or published.

publishedAt.description: On `live`: when live was pointed at this version.

publishedBy.description: On `live`: who pointed live at this version.

source.description: How a named version was made. Absent on the draft.

AgentWorkflow.description: The agent's workflow: the phases a conversation moves through.

capabilities.description: Groups of phases that each run with their own instructions and only their own tools. Absent: every phase shares one set of instructions and one set of tools.

entryPhase.description: The phase a new conversation starts in. Defaults to `answer`, the phase every agent has.

phases.description: The phases, in the order their journey steps are numbered. Always present when read. Lists are replaced whole: to change one phase, send them all back.

AnswerModelSettings.description: The answer job's model and its settings.

maxAttempts.description: How many times a failed call to the model is tried, from 1 to 10. Defaults to 3.

maxContinuations.description: How many times an answer that ran out of output may be continued, from 0 to 5. Defaults to 0, which is off.

maxOutputTokens.description: The most tokens the job may write, from 1 to 16,384. Defaults to 2,048.

model.description: The model, from `GET /v3/models`. Absent uses the job's default.

reasoning.description: Native reasoning, for a model that supports it; refused with 400 for one that does not.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature, from 0 to 1. Absent uses the model's default. Refused with 400 for a model that does not accept it (see `acceptsTemperature` in `GET /v3/models`).

topK.description: Top-K sampling, from 0 to 250. Absent uses the model's default.

topP.description: Nucleus sampling, from 0 to 1. Absent uses the model's default.

citations.description: How the agent cites its sources.

followUpQuestions.description: Whether the agent ends an answer by offering follow-up questions. Defaults to true.

mediaEmbeds.description: Whether the agent shows images and media from the passages it cites.

acceptedTypes.description: The file extensions accepted. Defaults to `pdf`, `docx`, `txt`, `csv` and `md`.

enabled.description: Whether people may attach documents in chat. Defaults to false.

maxByteSize.description: The largest document accepted, in bytes, from 102,400 (100 KB) to 10,485,760 (10 MB). Defaults to 4,718,592 (4.5 MB).

maxFiles.description: The most documents one conversation may hold, from 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.

AttributionChecks.description: Checks that an answer's claims are supported by what it cites.

maxRetries.description: How many times an answer that fails the check may be rewritten, from 0 to 10. Defaults to 2.

mode.description: What happens when an answer fails a check. Defaults to `record`.

model.description: The model that checks. Absent uses `models.planning`.

AvatarVoiceTuning.description: Adjustments to a live avatar's voice.

model.description: Which of the provider's voice models speaks. Absent uses the provider's default.

speed.description: How fast the avatar speaks, from 0.8 to 1.2. Defaults to 1.

stability.description: How steady the voice is, from 0 to 1. Absent uses the provider's default.

style.description: How much the voice exaggerates its style, from 0 to 1. Absent uses the provider's default.

Capability.description: A group of phases the agent handles as one area of work. While a conversation is in one of its phases, the model sees only the capability's instructions and its phases' tools. Moving into a phase of another capability hands the conversation over, with a summary for the next one.

conversationScope.description: Who a conversation in this capability is shared with. Absent decides nothing: the conversation keeps its sharing until it enters a capability that sets one.

description.description: What this capability does, in one sentence. The capability that receives a handover reads it.

id.description: The capability's identifier, unique within the workflow.

instructions.description: Added after the agent's instructions while the capability is active.

phases.description: The phases it owns, at least one. When capabilities are declared, every phase belongs to exactly one.

CitationSettings.description: How an agent cites its sources.

userMessages.description: Whether the agent may cite the person's own earlier messages. Defaults to false.

ConnectorBinding.description: One of the workspace's connectors an agent version may use.

connectorId.description: Which of the workspace's connectors the version may use. The caller must be able to read the connector; one it cannot read is refused with 404 `NOT_FOUND`.

ContentSafety.description: The guardrail that screens documents attached in chat.

guardrail.description: The ID of an entry in `GET /v3/guardrails`, `default` (the platform default, also used when absent) or `none`. The caller must be able to read the entry; one it cannot read is refused with 404 `NOT_FOUND`.

ConversationSettings.description: How the chat looks and behaves.

inputPlaceholder.description: The hint in the empty chat box, at most 200 characters. Absent or empty uses the workspace theme's.

timeZone.description: The time zone dates and "today" are read in, as an IANA name. Defaults to `Pacific/Auckland`.

FieldSource.description: One place a phase field's value may come from.

field.description: For `earlier_phase`: the field it was gathered as.

kind.description: Which place the value comes from. The other members name the tool, the fixed values or the earlier phase.

path.description: For `tool_result`: a path into the tool's output, for example `results[0].id`. Empty means the whole output.

phase.description: For `earlier_phase`: the phase that gathered the value.

toolName.description: For `tool_result`: the tool whose result holds the value.

values.description: For `allowed_values`: the values the field may take, at least one.

HoldingPhrases.description: What a live avatar says while an answer is being written.

followUp.description: What the avatar says to invite the person to clarify when no answer arrived.

groups.description: Groups of phrases, said one group after another while the answer is written.

intervalMs.description: Milliseconds between holding phrases, from 1,000 to 60,000.

openers.description: Phrases that acknowledge the person has finished speaking.

skipChance.description: The chance, from 0 to 1, that any one holding phrase is skipped, so the rhythm sounds less mechanical.

stillProcessing.description: What the avatar says when the answer is taking longer than usual.

JourneyIntroduction.description: The introduction on a journey page.

buttonLabel.description: The button, such as "Begin set-up" or "Continue in your set-up chat".

eyebrow.description: The small label above the title, such as "Getting started". Used on `start` only.

lead.description: The paragraph under the title. Required on `start`.

title.description: The title, such as "Welcome. Let's set up Caitlyn for your organisation."

JourneyPoster.description: The poster on a journey page.

footer.description: Short lines at the foot of the poster, one per line, at most 6.

label.description: The words on the poster, such as "Onboarding".

JourneySettings.description: The page shown for a stepped workflow: a poster on one side, and an introduction that changes once some steps are done. Its steps are the phases' `step` settings, numbered in the order their phases are declared; a step is done when its phases complete, or when its `doneWhen` signal says so.

poster.description: The poster beside the introduction. Always present when read.

resume.description: What a person sees once some steps are done or skipped. Always present when read.

start.description: What a person sees before they start. Always present when read.

JourneyStep.description: A phase's step on the journey page.

doneWhen.description: A named signal that shows the step done outside the chat, such as `workspaceHasCustomTheme`. Absent: the step is done when its phases complete.

id.description: Groups phases into steps on the journey page. Phases that share one form one step.

label.description: What the journey page calls the step, such as "Knowledge base".

KnowledgeBaseBinding.description: One knowledge base an agent searches, and how hard.

description.description: What it holds, so the agent knows when to search it, at most 2,000 characters. Absent uses the knowledge base's own `agentDescription`.

evaluation.description: How the passages a search finds are judged before they reach the answer. One method per search.

knowledgeBaseId.description: The knowledge base searched. The caller must be able to read it.

maxQueries.description: The most searches the agent may write for this knowledge base per question, from 1 to 20. Defaults to 3.

minimumRelevance.description: The lowest relevance an evaluated passage needs to reach the answer, from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.5.
